title: h5disp
summary: Return a textual summary of an HDF5 file, group, or dataset.

gpu_support.notes: Display traversal is host file I/O.

description: `h5disp(filename)` returns a display string for the file root. `h5disp(filename, location)` returns a display string for a specific object.
behaviors: The output lists groups, datasets, shapes, datatypes, and attributes.
RunMat returns the display text as a string so scripts can capture or print it deterministically.
